name: contentgen-ai
description: ContentGen AI - AI Storyboard and Video Generation
author: Jones Mbuso

scripts.test: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/stripCodeFence.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/vertexLocation.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/cloudClipAudio.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/gradioSSRF.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/safeCloneClean.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/exportRegistry.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/sanitizeAndParseJson.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx --import ./test/setupDom.ts test/patternInterrupt.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/depthProcessing.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/subtitleChunks.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/mp4ValidationAndChunks.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/awsRenderManager.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx test/cloudRenderHardening.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx --import ./test/setupDom.ts test/storyboardIntelligence.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx --import ./test/setupDom.ts test/timingValidationAndOutliers.test.ts
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vite build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --packages=external
scripts.deploy:run: gcloud run deploy contentgen-ai --source . --platform managed --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 3000 --cpu 1 --memory 2Gi --concurrency 80 --max-instances 1 --clear-base-image-args
scripts.deploy:in-memory: gcloud run deploy contentgen-ai --source . --platform managed --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 3000 --cpu 4 --memory 8Gi --timeout 3600 --concurrency 80 --max-instances 1 --clear-base-image-args
scripts.remotion:build: npm --prefix remotion run build && npm --prefix remotion run bundle
scripts.remotion:deploy:contentgen: npm --prefix remotion run bundle && node scripts/deploy-remotion-s3.js
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm --prefix electron run dev"
